item.title: Person killed in Chatham drive-by shooting
item.description: <p>A person was shot to death Saturday in the Chatham neighborhood.</p><p>The victim, who police described as a male whose age wasn’t known, was near a sidewalk about 5:30 p.m. in the 7900 block of South Ingleside Avenue when an occupant in a car opened fire, Chicago police said.</p><p>He was shot multiple times and was taken to University of Chicago Medical Center, where he was pronounced dead, police said.</p><p>No one is in custody.</p>

item.title: Man, 19, killed in Auburn Gresham shooting
item.description: <p>A 19-year-old man was shot and killed Saturday in Auburn Gresham.</p><p>The man was inside a home about 5 p.m. in the 7700 block of South Racine Avenue when someone in a passing car fired shots, striking the man in the head, Chicago police said. </p><p>He was pronounced dead at the scene, police said. He was identified as Michael Rounds Jr. by the Cook County medical examiner's office.</p><p>Area detectives are investigating.</p>

item.title: 3 shot, 1 fatally, in Albany Park basement
item.description: <p>Three people were shot, one fatally, in a residential basement Saturday in Albany Park.</p><p>The three were shot by someone not known to them just before 3 p.m. at a home in the 4900 block of North Harding Avenue, Chicago police said.</p><p>A 24-year-old man suffered multiple gunshot wounds and was pronounced dead at the scene, police said.</p><p>Another man, 29, was shot in the foot and a third man, 34, was shot in the leg.
